chapter: Morrison's, the Slipper and leaving music
title: Dropping out of music around 1931-32 during the Depression
summary: After Morrison's, the Slipper, the Nut Club and the Ladoo he left music to settle down, returning only with later bands.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Will an aide go to room two, please. Room two for an aide, please. I think that just about after Morrison's and the slipper, and the nut club and the Ladoo, that's where he dropped out of music. That's where he dropped out at that time. Long enough to settle down so I could go to school. We were in the ground and we were changing schools. It didn't break, so he stayed together.
About what year was that you might remember?
I think that this was around 1931-32.
The Depression was on then, too. That one's a bit tough.

Well, he played the Morrison's during the Depression. Probably had gone back to Morrison's after these other engagements. He didn't pick up with his music again until these Willis Fall bands came together.
